SELECT TEP.*,T.OUTSOURCNAME FROM ( SELECT MAX(T6.MSGDEPTNAME) DEPTNAME,MAX(T1.CREATETIME) CREATETIME, MAX(T2.WBSID) WBSID,MAX(T2.MSNAME)MSNAME,MAX(T2.IDCARD)IDCARD, MAX(T2.INTERVIEWRESULT)INTERVIEWRESULT, MAX(T2.SEX)SEX,MAX(T2.BIRTHDAY)BIRTHDAY, MAX(T2.SUGGESTLEVEL)SUGGESTLEVEL, MAX(T2.WORKYEARS)WORKYEARS,MAX(T2.POSITION)POSITION,MAX(T2.SUGGESTPRICE) SUGGESTPRICE, MAX(T3.ISRZ)ISRZ,MAX(T2.JL) JL,MAX(T2.SCORE)SCORE, MAX(T6.MSGDEPTNO) DEPTNO, MAX(T1.APPLYER)APPLYER , MAX(T1.INSTANCEID)INSTANCEID,MAX(T1.RL_ID)RL_ID, MAX(T2.RESEARCHERS)RESEARCHERS FROM PPM_INTERVIEW_APPLY T1 INNER JOIN PPM_INTERVIEWEE_INFO T2 ON(T1.INSTANCEID=T2.INSTANCEID) left join PPM_INTERVIEWER_INFO T6 ON(T1.INSTANCEID=T6.INSTANCEID) LEFT JOIN PPM_INTERVIEWEE_OVERINFO T3 ON(T1.INSTANCEID=T3.INSTANCEID) GROUP BY T2.ID HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) >= 1 ) TEP LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_INFO T ON(TEP.WBSID = T.ID)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PPM.PPM_RLWBXQ_PERSON_INFO(ID,IDCARD,FILEID,DEPTNAME,DEPTNO, COMPANYID,COMPANY,POSITION,EXAMNUM,EXAMRESULT,REMARK, CREATETIME,STATUS,SEX,BIRTHDAY,WORKYEARS,SUGGESTLEVEL, SUGGESTPRICE) SELECT -ID , O.IDCARD, (SELECT D.OBJECTNO FROM PPM.PPM_DOCUMENT D WHERE D.DOCUMENTNO= O.JL ) FILEID, (SELECT SUBSTR(T.LOCATION, INSTR(T.LOCATION,'-')+1) LOCATION FROM PPM.COMM_DEPARTMENT T WHERE T.DEPID= (SELECT MSGDEPTNO FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWER_INFO T3 WHERE T3.INSTANCEID=O.INSTANCEID AND ROWNUM=1) )DEPTNAME, (SELECT MSGDEPTNO FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWER_INFO T3 WHERE T3.INSTANCEID=O.INSTANCEID AND ROWNUM=1) DEPTNO , WBSID, (SELECT T1.OUTSOURCNAME FROM PPM.PPM_OUTSOURCING_INFO T1 WHERE T1.ID=O.WBSID)COMPANY, POSITION, SCORE , '通过' AS EXAMRESULT, 'NEW' REMARK,CREATETIME ,2, CASE SEX WHEN '0' THEN '女' WHEN '1' THEN '男' END SEX, BIRTHDAY ,WORKYEARS ,SUGGESTLEVEL ,SUGGESTPRICE FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWEE_OVERINFO O RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT Y.IDCARD,MAX(Y.ID) YID FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWEE_OVERINFO Y WHERE INTERVIEWRESULT=1 GROUP BY Y.IDCARD) T5 ON (T5.YID=O.ID) WHERE O.INTERVIEWRESULT=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PPM.PPM_RLWBXQ_PERSON_INFO T2 WHERE O.IDCARD=T2.IDCARD )

INSERT INTO PPM.PPM_RLWBXQ_EXAMPERSON_INFO(ID,IDCARD,NAME,ZCJ,ISPASS,CONTENT, PRICE) SELECT -ID,O.IDCARD, MSNAME,SCORE,'1' ISPASS,'NEW' CONTENT,SUGGESTPRICE FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWEE_OVERINFO O RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT Y.IDCARD,MAX(Y.ID) YID FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWEE_OVERINFO Y WHERE INTERVIEWRESULT=1 GROUP BY Y.IDCARD) T5 ON (T5.YID=O.ID) WHERE O.INTERVIEWRESULT=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PPM.PPM_RLWBXQ_EXAMPERSON_INFO T2 WHERE O.IDCARD=T2.IDCARD )

INSERT INTO PPM.PPM_RLWBXQ_GRADE_INFO(ID,TEACHERID,TEACHERNAME,TEACHERDEPT, TEACHERDEPTNO,GRADEZY,GRADEZH,GRADEJJ,GRADEXX,REMARK,PID) SELECT -T1.ID AS AID, T3.MSGID, T3.MSGNAME, (SELECT MSGDEPTNAME FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWER_INFO T WHERE T.MSGID=T3.MSGID AND T.INSTANCEID=T1.INSTANCEID )MSGDEPTNAME, (SELECT MSGDEPTNO FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWER_INFO T WHERE T.MSGID=T3.MSGID AND T.INSTANCEID=T1.INSTANCEID )MSGDEPTNO, T3.TECHNOLOGY,T3.COMPREHENSIVE,T3.EDUCATION,T3.EXPERIENCE,T3.REMARK,-T1.ID FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWEE_OVERINFO T1 LEFT JOIN PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWEE_SCOREINFO T3 ON(T1.INSTANCEID=T3.INSTANCEID) RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT Y.IDCARD,MAX(Y.ID) YID FROM PPM.PPM_INTERVIEWEE_OVERINFO Y WHERE INTERVIEWRESULT=1 GROUP BY Y.IDCARD) T5 ON (T5.YID=T1.ID) WHERE T1.INTERVIEWRESULT=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PPM.PPM_RLWBXQ_GRADE_INFO T5 WHERE T5.ID=-T1.ID )
